card.name: Units and "or" right after a number
card.fires_on: The percent sign, unit, dash or the word "or" that comes straight after a number. It marks a value about to be given as a range, limit or approximation, such as "or below" or "or so".

modes.label: Percent after a number
modes.description: The % sign or the word percent right after a small decimal figure, usually an incidence rate.
modes.example: Anaphylactic shock resulting in death has occurred in approximately 0.002<<%>> of the patients treated.

modes.label: "or" after a number
modes.description: The word "or" after a number or unit, leading into a limit such as "or higher", "or below" or "or so".
modes.example: Sports such as racquetball, tennis and badminton may seem relatively harmless, but they involve objects moving at 60 miles per hour<< or>> faster.

modes.label: Dash or degree unit
modes.description: A dash after a dollar figure, or a degree unit after a temperature number.
modes.example: The refrigerator should be set at 4<<°C>> (40°F) or colder and

card.plain: It fires on the small mark or word right after a number, where the text says "or more", "or below" or gives a rate.
